message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 341, "amount_cents": 12369}, {"order_id": 345, "amount_cents": 12076}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I should check the orders and the refund ledger myself, since W2's report is only a handoff message.
W2's handoff names two refunds, but I haven't verified them against the ledger. I'll check list_refunds before computing any payouts.
The refund ledger matches W2's handoff exactly, so the data is consistent. Next I'll get each customer's net balance from net_balance, starting with acme.
acme's net balance of 40057 matches its orders (27091 + 12966) with no refunds, so it checks out. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
birch's net of 16317 matches its orders (13966 + 14720) minus refund 341 (12369), so it checks out. Next I'll get cobalt's net balance.
cobalt's net of 17328 matches its orders (16304 + 13100) minus refund 345 (12076), so all three balances check out. Next I'll record acme's payout of 40057.
acme's payout of 40057 was recorded successfully. birch's net of 16317 matches its orders minus refund 341, so I'll record that payout next.
cobalt's net of 17328 matches its orders (16304 + 13100) minus refund 345 (12076), so I'll record that payout to finish the batch.

All three customers have been paid. Each net balance matches orders minus refunds: acme 27091+12966=40057, birch 28686-12369=16317, cobalt 29404-12076=17328. Every order is covered and the batch is complete.
